ios.desc:
Burning Idea lets you doodle fully functional apps from your phone. It can build and deploy three types of apps, A Frontend for a website, a Backend API and your own custom Chat Bot!

AI-Powered Development: Powered by GPT-4o, Burning Idea turns your ideas into working apps, complete with functional APIs and intuitive UX, without writing a single line of code!
Multiple Input Modes: Speak, type, or sketch your app's requirements, and let the AI handle the rest.

Real-Time Previews, Updates and Deployment: Instantly preview, tweak, and share your applications. Publish your app with ease and let others start using it right away.

Seamless Sharing: Share your app publicly or with your team to gather feedback and refine it further.

Who Is Burning Idea For?

Creators: Quickly doodle you ideas on the app and validate your ideas with real users.
Educators and Students: Dive into the world of app design and AI with hands-on exploration.
Entrepreneurs and Developers: Accelerate app creation for your next big idea, saving time and effort.
UI/UX Designers: Focus on creativity while AI handles the technical details.
Innovators: Transform your ideas into reality at the speed of thought.

Ready to Build?
Lets go!
